ruff.command: python -m ruff check services/api/job_attempt_replay.py services/api/routers/jobs.py tests/test_job_attempt_replay.py tests/test_recovery.py

ruff_format.command: python -m ruff format --check services/api/job_attempt_replay.py services/api/routers/jobs.py tests/test_job_attempt_replay.py tests/test_recovery.py

properties: Retry timeline is deterministic across input ordering and content-hashed.
Unlinked retry events and attempt-number gaps remain visible and mark persisted history noncontiguous.
Manual retry queue delay since prior failure is recorded when events can be linked.
The API exposes the replay timeline with existing job state.
limitations: No automatic backoff scheduler exists; replay reports an empty automatic backoff history.
Attempt start times and full lease-recovery scheduling events are not persisted; full timing replay is explicitly unavailable.
